comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hey @zgabi, thanks for the crash report and the reproduction steps — super helpful! 🙏

## Root Cause

The crash happens in ObjectListView's `DrawAllDecorations` method which iterates sub-items assuming they're all `OLVListSubItem` objects:

```csharp
foreach (OLVListSubItem subItem in olvi.SubItems)  // InvalidCastException!
```

When Smart Groups are populated after importing connections, some list items end up with plain `ListViewSubItem` objects instead of the expected `OLVListSubItem` type. ...

@zgabi, update on the two remaining issues you reported here:

### 1. Connections not saved after import → **Fixed in `47416d4`** ✅

This was the same root cause as #75 — the settings provider conflict caused settings (including the connection file path) to not persist. After the fix, imported connections should now survive a restart.

### 2. Connections visible in Smart Groups but not in Connections tree

This one we need your help to verify — it might have been a side effect of the settings is...
